name: LFM2.5 24B A2B Q8_0 on one Intel Arc Pro B70 (exact fast path)

library.summary: Liquid AI's LFM2.5 24B mixture-of-experts (about 2B active) on one Arc Pro B70 in 8-bit form, 3.3x faster than llama.cpp's plain SYCL path with every token and log-probability identical to it, and prompts read at about 1,700 tokens a second.

featured_metric.label: strict class-balanced decode
featured_metric.scope: Median of two fresh-server class-balanced medians over the complete 12-prompt/six-class, 512-cap, cache-zero native HTTP suite; one B70, one user, F16 KV, 32K context. Every token array identical to the plain SYCL reference path (12/12 on both servers), top-8 log-probabilities bit-identical on the 12-prompt probe and three long prompts; canaries passed.

library.benchmark_status: Package check 2026-10-15 (v3): built from this folder by build.sh and run by serve.sh; reference 41.7 tok/s and the unfused fast path 111.7 tok/s on the same build. The server reads prompts at 1,709 / 1,652 / 1,247 tok/s (1,775 / 7,314 / 26,138 tokens), where the previous build read 1,124 / 1,119 / 924.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Bring-up, exact reordered-layout kernels (DMMV and expert MMVQ in the reference order), twelve exact kernel fusions, a steadier prompt-path weight conversion, identity gates, package.
contributors.validated_effect: 41.7 -> 137.2 tok/s with identical output; prompts read 35-52% faster than the previous build

performance_profiles.label: Raw decode over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rate on the fast path (tg128, fa on, F16 KV, 3 reps each); not the HTTP suite metric. Measured points only.

performance_profiles.label: Raw pp2048 over existing context depth
performance_profiles.scope: llama-bench raw engine rate on the fast path (pp2048, each measured right after a tg128 run, so on the weight layout a running server uses; fa on, F16 KV, 3 reps each). Measured points only.

performance_profiles.label: Prompt reading speed as the server reports it
performance_profiles.public_label: Reading speed (prefill) · one user · server counters
performance_profiles.public_scope: How fast the server reads a whole prompt before the answer starts, by the server's own counters, one user, prompt cache off, after it has answered other requests.
performance_profiles.scope: serve.sh fast, server B of the package check; three long prompts (lab text), each twice; mean of the two.

known_limitations: Measured with one user (--parallel 1), prompt cache off, 32K context; identity with several users or the prompt cache on has not been checked.
Identical output is proven against the plain SYCL path of the same build, not against other backends.
Clean-host install (driver and oneAPI) not yet replayed.

commands.stop: Ctrl-C in the serve.sh terminal (it runs in the foreground)
